text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every Christmas, the Mejiros hold a fan appreciation event—
and today, we came to the venue
to help with preparations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it's so spacious!
We get to decorate all of this ourselves?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, if each of us decorates it in our own style,
it's sure to show our individuality~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I thought doing that would bring joy
to each and every one of our fans~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're done checking the venue,
so let's go buy the decorations!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer and I will stay behind to get things ready. We'll clean up so it's easier to decorate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho... Is this good for the stuff by the wall?
Trainer, are you holding up okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, "not yet," huh?
Let's take a quick breather then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Squeeeak... tap, tap, tap...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, the sound of the door opening rang out.
It seems the shopping group came back at the perfect time!
choice_data_list: Let's go help carry the luggage!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Wait.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Isn't something wrong?
I can't hear anyone's voice...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Now that you mention it, it's unnervingly quiet.
Could five Mejiro Umamusume who went out together really not utter a single sound...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh crap!
Is there anything we can use as a weapon?! Ah, should we run?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"No way, absolutely not! Not you, Trainer!
Normally, I'm the one who should go!"
choice_data_list: Still, I wouldn't want you getting hurt, Palmer...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Because I'd hate it if you got hurt, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...You know who I am, right?
I'm Palmer, famous for runaway escapes!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You know I can dodge any danger in a flash, easy-peasy!
...So, pretty please?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her smile is clearly putting on a brave face.
It's painfully obvious she's trying to reassure me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm off!
C'mon, you just gotta believe in me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tap, tap... Creak, click)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Did someone just go into another room...?
choice_data_list: ...Let's go together! Bring something to defend ourselves with!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, safety first! Take a quick look, then immediately back away and run!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Keep an eye on the thief, and the moment their face is visible,
escape immediately. ...If spotted by any chance,
the plan is to throw a plastic bottle at them.
choice_data_list: I'll splash the contents on them to make them flinch...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yes! While they're shaken up, a runaway escape!
With me taking Trainer with me, of course!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: *deep breath*... Alright, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...!
Someone's sitting on the sofa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I can't see it clearly. Just a little more,
just a bit further... if it opens up, I might see...
I can see you all clearly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Ramonu...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Which means...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm seriously so glad it was just a misunderstanding~~!
I was freaking out thinking,
'What if I can't help Trainer escape?!' and all sorts of things~!
choice_data_list: Before that, I want you to worry about yourself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"That goes for both of us!
When you said you were going to check things out,
you had me totally freaked out, you know~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...You two seem so close.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Ah, umm... ahaha~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm back~!
...Wait, Palmer, what's going on with you guys? Why are you gripping cues and plastic bottles?
choice_data_list: Looks like we got the wrong idea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While house-sitting, I told a story about how I panicked,
mistaking Mejiro Ramonu's footsteps for a burglar's...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Heh, ahahaha! So that's why you're dressed like that?
I'm glad everything turned out fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It really is~... You worried me, and I worried you,
it's just, geez...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, time to bounce back from here!
Let's have a ton of fuuuun!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "They are staring... deep into each other's eyes~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what!?
Ah, no, I mean... Man, this is tough~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "How should I explain this bizarre situation? It was undoubtedly out of mutual care for one another... but saying it aloud felt too embarrassing, so I had no choice but to remain silent."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, exactly! What kind of decorations did you buy?
I suuuuper wanna see!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...To think they're both so clumsy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a wry smile, I awkwardly began decorating.
Still, I thought to myself that maybe
we really were two of a kind.
